newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese court sentences dissident to 11 years.
newsitem.headline: Chinese court sentences dissident to 11 years.

text.p: A Chinese court on Wednesday convicted prominent dissident and former student leader Wang Dan of plotting to overthrow the government and sentenced him to 11 years in prison.
The Beijing Number One Intermediate People's Court ruled that Wang was guilty of conspiring to subvert the Chinese government, the Xinhua news agency said.
The former student leader was deprived of his political rights for two years, the verdict said.
The trial opened at 9.00 a.m. (0100 GMT) on Wednesday and the verdict was announced just four hours later. The statement gave no more details.
